name: Jerahme'el
title: Hezron's firstborn son
summary: Jerahme'el was the firstborn son of Hezron, grandson of Perez, and great-grandson of Judah. He is an important figure in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, and his descendants formed the Jerahmeelites, a clan mentioned in connection with David during his time in the wilderness. His lineage is thoroughly documented in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Jerahme'el's Birth and Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jerahme'el is recorded as the firstborn son of Hezron in the tribal genealogy of Judah. His position as the firstborn gave him a special place in family history.

keyEvents.title: Jerahme'el's Sons
keyEvents.description: The sons of Jerahme'el with his first wife are listed: Ram, Bunah, Oren, Osem, and Ahijah. These formed the foundation of the Jerahmeelite clan.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Atarah
keyEvents.description: Jerahme'el also had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam. This shows that he had two wives, which was common in patriarchal times.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of Jerahme'el's Descendants
keyEvents.description: The detailed genealogy of Jerahme'el's descendants is preserved in 1 Chronicles and shows an extensive family line through several generations.

keyEvents.title: The Jerahmeelites in David's Time
keyEvents.description: David's connection with the Jerahmeelites is documented when he stayed in the Negev wilderness. David sent part of the war spoils to the cities of the Jerahmeelites as a diplomatic gesture.

keyEvents.title: Jerahmeelite Territory
keyEvents.description: The Jerahmeelites had their territory in the southern part of the Negev. This area was known as the Negev of the Jerahmeelites and was a distinct region in southern Judah.
